v: Ayik ayoch heb' juez yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel, ix jawi jun niwan wejel t'a chonhab' chi'. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay jun winh aj chonhab' Belén t'a yol yik Judá, ix b'at kajnaj winh yet' ix yetb'eyum yet' chawanh yuninal t'a yol yik Moab yuj jun wejel chi'.

Ha jun winh chi', Elimelec sb'i winh, haxo ix yetb'eyum winh, Noemí sb'i ix. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh chi', haton winhaj Mahlón yet' winhaj Quelión. Aj Efrata heb', Belén pax sb'i. Ix b'atkan kajan heb' t'a yol yik Moab chi'. Lajunhe' ab'il ix ek' heb' ta'. Yakb'an ayek' heb' chi' ta', ix cham winhaj Elimelec yetb'eyum ix Noemí chi', ix kan ix yet' chawanh heb' winh yune' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix och yetb'eyum heb' winh schawanhil. Ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' chawanh heb' ix aj Moab chi', jun ix skuch Orfa, haxo junxo ix skuch Rut.
Haxo ix aji, ix champax winhaj Mahlón yet' winhaj Quelión chi', yuj chi' ix kan ix Noemí sch'okoj, yujto ix cham heb' winh yune' ix chi', ix champax winh yetb'eyum ix.
Haxo ix yab'an ix Noemí chi' to ix ok'xi sk'o'ol Jehová t'a chonhab' Israel, manhxalaj wejel ta'.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj ix t'a Judá yet' chawanh heb' ix yalib' chi'.

Ayik wan skot heb' ix t'a yoltak b'e, ix yalan ix t'a heb' ix yalib' chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, paxanhek t'a spat he mam he nun. Ha Jehová ol och heyet'ok yujto wach'nhej ix heyutej he b'a t'ayin yet' t'a heb' winh wune'.
A'okab' Jehová ol och heyet'ok yik ol ochxok heyetb'eyum, wach'nhej ol aj heyajxi'ek' t'a he pat, xchi ix. Ix tz'ub'anelta sti' heb' ix yalib' ix chi', ix syamanoch heb' ix yok'i.
Ix yalan heb' ix icha tik: --Max honh kanlaj. Ol honh b'at het'ok t'a ha chonhab' chi', xchi heb' ix.
Ix yalanxi ix t'a heb' ix: --Hex walib', paxanhek t'a he pat. ¿Tasto wal yuj tzex och tzak'an wu'uj? Malaj wune' toxo tz'aji yik tzeyik'lan he b'a yet'ok.
Yuj chi' ixikek, paxanhek t'a he pat. Yujto ha hin tik, chichim hinxo, manhxo ol ochlaj wetb'eyum. Wach'chom swal tikne'ik to ha t'a jun ak'wal tik ol och wetb'eyum, olto aljok wune', ta xin chi,

¿palta tom olto he tanhwej sk'ib' heb' winh, yik ol heyik'an he b'a yet' heb' winh? ¿Tom yujnhej he tanhwani, manhxo ol och heyetb'eyum? Ma'ay hex walib', manh ol yal-laj icha chi'. Ha hin tik, wiktaxon yaj yahelal ix yak'kot Jehová t'a wib'anh. Ol am hin te kus heyu'uj tato ol wila' to ol heyab' sya'il, xchi ix t'a heb' ix yalib' chi'.
Ix ochxi ijan heb' ix yok'i. Ixlajwi chi', haxo ix Orfa ix tz'ub'ankanelta sti' ix, ix meltzaj ix. Haxo pax ix Rut jun, ix kannhej ix yet' ix.
Ix yalanxi ix Noemí chi' t'a ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Tzam ila' to ha ix ha mu' toxo ix pax ix t'a schonhab' yet' t'a sdiosal, ixik pax ha hach tik, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Manh hach och ijan halan t'ayin yik tzach waktejkani. Yalnhej b'aj ol hach b'atok, ol hin b'atnhej het'ok. Ha b'aj ol hach ajok, hata' ol hin aj pax het'ok. Ha ha chonhab', ha ol och hin chonhab'ok, ha ha Diosal, ha ol ochpax hin Diosalok.
Ha b'aj ol hach chamok, hata' ol hin champaxok, hata' ol hin muknajok. Yak'okab' hin yahelal Jehová tato tzach waktejkani, masanto ha chamel ol ik'an ko pojan ko b'a, xchi ix Rut chi'.
Haxo ix yilan ix Noemí chi' to ay wal och t'a sk'o'ol ix Rut chi' sb'at yet'ok, manhxalaj tas ix yal ix t'a ix.

Ix b'eyxikot heb' ix schawanhil, masanto ix jawi heb' ix t'a Belén. Ayik ix jawi heb' ix ta', masanil heb' anima ay ta' ix te sat sk'o'ol heb'. Ix yalan heb' ix ix icha tik: --¿Mantok ha ix Noemí tik? xchi heb' ix.
Yuj chi' ix tak'wi ix t'a heb' ix icha tik: --Manhxo heyal Noemí t'ayin, palta Mara tzeyak' hin b'i'ej, yujto ha Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil, ha' ix ak'an hin yahelal.

Ayik ix hin b'at t'a tik, manh jantakok tas ay t'ayin, haxo yik tzin meltzaj tik, manhxalaj jab'ok. Icha chi' ix el t'a sk'o'ol Jehová sjawi t'a wib'anh, ¿tasto wal yuj tzeyal Noemí chi' t'ayin yujto toxo ix ja t'a wib'anh wab'an sya'il yuj Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil? xchi ix.
Ichaton chi' ix aj sjawi ix Noemí yet' ix Rut t'a Belén chi', spetoj heb' ix t'a yol yik Moab. Ha ix jawi heb' ix chi', wan wal syamchajoch sjochchaj ixim cebada.
Ay jun winh skuchan Booz, ayto yuj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Elimelec yetb'eyumkan ix Noemí chi'. Te b'eyum winh, niwan yelk'och winh t'a schonhab' chi'.

Ix yal ix Rut chi' t'a ix Noemí icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach, komonok tzin ha chab'ati, b'at wila' talaj ay b'aj wan sjochchaj ixim cebada, talaj scha sk'o'ol heb' winh aj munlajel chi' tzin sik' jaye'ok sjolom kik t'a spatiktak heb' winh, xchi ix. --Ixik, xchi ix.

Ix b'at ix Rut chi' b'aj wan sjochchaj ixim cebada chi', ix och ijan ix sik'an ixim skan yuj heb' winh sjochan ixim chi'. k'okb'il wal ha jun munlajel b'aj ix k'och ix chi' yik winhaj Booz, haton jun winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh xilb'a Elimelec chi'.

Ayik wan sik'an ixim ix, ix k'och winhaj Booz chi', spetoj winh t'a Belén. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' smunlajwum chi' icha tik: --A'okab' Jehová ayoch heyet'ok, xchi winh. --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayach, xchi heb' munlajwum chi' t'a winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh ayoch yil heb' smunlajwum chi': --¿Mach ay yik jun ix kob'es chi'? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winh: --Haton jun ix aj Moab ix jawi yet' ix Noemí.

Ix sk'an spermiso ix t'ayin yik tzek' ix t'a skal ixim jochb'ilxo, yik sik'ancha'anh ixim skan yuj heb' munlajwum tik ix. Atax t'a k'inhib'alil ix jawi ix, max och wa'an ix sik'ancha'anh ixim, hato wal yik'an yip ix tik, xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' t'a ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Ach ix, ab' tas ol wala': Manhxo hach b'at ha sik'cha'anh ixim cebada tik t'a yik junokxo mach, palta kananh yet' heb' ix hin chekab' tik.

Ha yet' heb' ix ol hach b'at b'aj sjochwi cebada heb' winh hin munlajwum tik. Toxo ix wal t'a heb' winh to malaj tas syal heb' winh t'ayach. Ayik stakji ha ti', syal ik'anelta ha' uk' t'a yol ch'ub' b'aj syik'elta yik heb' winh hin munlajwum chi', xchi winh t'a ix.
Ayik ix yab'an ix icha chi', ix em nhojan ix t'a sat lu'um, ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj te wach' tzutej ha k'o'ol t'ayin, ina to ha hin tik ch'ok chonhab'il hin? xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix icha tik: --Yujto ix wab' masanil tas ix ha k'ulej t'a ix alib' atax yik ix cham winh etb'eyum, ix aktejkan ha mam ha nun yet' ha chonhab' b'aj aljinak hach, ix hach ja t'a ko chonhab' to manh ojtakoktaxon tik.
A'okab' Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik tz'ak'an spak t'ayach yuj tas ix ha k'ulej chi', syak'an swach'k'olal t'ayach, haton ko Diosal b'aj ix hach jawi ha kol ha b'a tik, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi ix icha tik: --Mamin, ste tzalaj hin k'o'ol yuj tas tzal tik t'ayin, te wach' tzutej ha k'o'ol t'ayin wach'chom manh hin lajanok yet' junok heb' ix ha chekab' tik, xchi ix.

Ayik ix k'och yora'il swa heb', ix yawtejkot ix Rut chi' winh wa'el, ix yalanh winh icha tik: --Kotanh, wa'anh ket'ok. Lab'ejem ixim ha pan chi' t'a skal vinagre tik, xchi winh. Ix em k'ojan ix t'a stz'ey heb' munlajwum chi', ix yak'an ixim mayb'il cebada winh t'a ix, yik sk'ux ix yet' swa'el chi'. Ix wa ix masanto ix b'ut'ji ix, ayto maj lajwilaj yuj ix.

Ayik ix b'atxi ix sik'oj cebada chi', ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' t'a heb' winh smunlajwum chi' icha tik: --Ha ixim somchajb'at t'a skal ixim manojaxo yaj chi', syal sik'an ixim ix. Manh heyak' k'ixwelal ix.
Syal heyaktankan junjunok ixim manojaxo yaj chi' yik sik'cha'anh ixim ix. Manh he tumej ix, xchi winh.
Haxo yik wanxo yem k'u, ix yaktan ix sik'an ixim, ix smak'anel ixim ix, ay am oxe'ok almul ixim ix yik' ix.

Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj ix t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix sch'oxan ix t'a ix yalib' chi' jantak ixim ix yik' ix. Yet'nak pax ixim mayb'il cebada chi' ix t'a ix yalib' chi', haton ixim maj lajwoklaj sk'uxan ix chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an ix yalib' ix chi' t'ay: ¿Mach ay yik b'aj hach xit'ek' chi'? ¿B'ajtil ix ha sik' ixim cebada tik? Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh jun mach wach' ix yutej sb'a chi' t'ayach, xchi ix. Ix yalan ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Ha jun winh ay yik b'aj hin xit'ek' chi', Booz sb'i winh, xchi ix.

Ix yalanxi ix yalib' ix chi' icha tik: --Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Booz chi', yujto wach' syutej spensar winh t'ayonh ha honh pitzan honh tik, icha yutejnak spensar winh t'a heb' winh ko chamnak. Ix yalanxi ix: --Ha winh chi' te ayto ku'uj ko b'a yet' winh, yuj chi' smoj ton skolwaj winh t'ayonh, xchi ix.

Ix yalan ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Ix yalpax winh t'ayin icha tik: Syal ha kotnhej ha sik' ixim, anhej yet' heb' ix hin chekab' tik tzach b'ati, masanto ol lajwok munlajel tik, xchi winh t'ayin, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi ix yalib' ix chi': Wach' jun hach walib', wach' tato tzach b'atnhej yet' heb' ix schekab' winh chi', max hach b'atlaj t'a junokxo ch'ok, yik wach' malaj mach tzach tzuntzani, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej ix Rut yet' heb' ix schekab' winhaj Booz chi', masanto ix lajwi sjochchaj ixim cebada yet' ixim trigo. Aynhejek' ix Rut yet' ix yalib' chi'.
Ay jun k'u ix yal ix Noemí t'a ix yalib' chi' icha tik: --Ach Rut, smoj tzin say junok etb'eyum nu yik wach' tzalajk'olal tzach aji.
Ha winhaj Booz, winh ay schekab' heb' ix junnhej ix hach munlaj chi' yet'ok, te ayto ku'uj ko b'a yet' winh. Ha t'a jun ak'wal tik ol b'at winh ak'ojel matz'il cebada.

Ha tikne'ik, icha tik ol ha k'ulej: B'ikel ha b'a, tzak'anek' perfume t'ayach, ha ha pichul wach' tzak'ochi, tzach b'at b'aj ayek' winh chi', palta manh ha komon ch'oxej ha b'a ayik manto lajwi swa winh.

Tonhej tzila' b'ajtil tzek' jichan winh swayi, slajwi chi' tzach ek' jichan t'a yoktak winh, tzak'ank'e sti' sk'u' winh t'a yoktak chi' t'a ib'anh. Haxo winh ol alanok tas ol ha k'ulej, xchi ix Noemí chi'.
Ix tak'wi ix Rut chi' icha tik: --Ol hin k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix al tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix b'at ix b'aj smunlaj winhaj Booz chi', ix sk'anab'ajej ix icha ix aj yalan ix yalib' chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi swa winhaj Booz chi' yet' yuk'an ha', te tzalajk'olal ix aj winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix ek' jichan winh sway t'a slak'anil b'aj kunhanek' ixim sat cebada chi'. Haxo yik ix k'e ak'wal, te k'ojank'olal ix aj sk'och ix Rut chi', ix yik'ancha'anh sk'u' winh ix t'a yoktak, ix ek' jichan ix sway ta'.
Haxo t'a chimilak'wal ix k'e juknaj winh, ix sutmaj winh b'aj waynak chi', haxo ix yab'an winh to ay jun ix ix jichanek' t'a yoktak chi'.
--¿Mach hach? xchi winh. --Ha hin Rut hin ha chekab' hin. Ha hach tik, smoj tzach kolwaj t'ayin, yujto te ayto uj ha b'a yet' winh wetb'eyum chamnak, xchi ix.

--Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayach. Ha tikne'ik, ix nachajel wu'uj chajtil to wach' ha pensar, yujto tza nib'ej sb'inajkan winh etb'eyum chamnak. K'inalok ta manh ichokta, syal ik'an ha b'a yet' junokxo winh to kelemto, wach'chom meb'a', ma b'eyum, anhej tato syal ha k'o'ol, palta maj ha k'ulej icha chi'.
Manh ak' pensar, yujto ha t'a yol ko chonhab' tik, ojtakab'ilxo to wach' ha b'inaji, yuj chi' ol hin k'anab'ajej masanil tas tzal tik.
Yeltoni ayto wu'uj hin b'a het'ok, palta ayto wal junxo winh te ayto uj ha b'a yet'ok t'a wichanh.

Kananh t'a tik t'a jun ak'wal tik. Hato k'ik'an swala', tato scha sk'o'ol winh chi' hach yik'an icha sleyal. Tato icha chi', wach' toni. Tato manh ol yal sk'o'ol winh jun, swak' hin ti' t'a yichanh Jehová hach wik'ani. Wayanh tikne'ik, haxo yik ol sakb'ok, ol hach paxok, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix waykan ix t'a yoktak winhaj Booz chi' t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Ayto sakb'i ix k'e wa'an ix, yujto ix yal winh t'a ix to malajokab' mach tz'ilani to ay junok ix ix, ix ulek' b'aj smunlaj winh chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: --Ik'el ha xotil chi', tza pixan snhi' k'apak, xchi winh t'a ix. Ayik yamb'il snhi' k'apak xotil ix chi' yuj, ix sekanem ixim cebada winh t'a yo'ol, ay am wake'ok almul ixim ix yak'em winh. Ix schelank'e winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab' ix, ix yik'anb'at ixim ix t'a chonhab' chi'.
Haxo ix k'och ix t'a ix yalib' chi', ix sk'anb'an ix: --¿Tas ix ha k'ulej nu? xchi ix. Ix yalan ix Rut chi' tas ix yal winhaj Booz chi' icha tik:
--Ha masanil ixim cebada tik ix yak' winh t'ayin. Ix yalanpax winh to max yal hin jawi t'ayach tato malaj jab'ok tas wet'nak, xchi ix.
Ix yalan ix yalib' ix chi': --Ha tikne'ik jun nu, tanhwej tas ol ajelk'och jun tik. Manh ol ek' tiempo yuj winh. Ol sb'o yaj winh tikne'ik, xchi ix t'a ix Rut chi'.

Haxo yik ix sakb'i, ix b'at em k'ojan winhaj Booz chi' t'a sti' spuerta'il chonhab' b'aj smolb'ejtaxon sb'a heb' anima. Junanto wal rato chi', ix elul winh te ayto yuj sb'a yet' winh xilb'a Elimelec chi', haton jun winh ix yal winhaj Booz chi' t'a ix Rut. Ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' t'a winh: --Ochanh wa'an to ol honh lolon jab'ok, xchi winh. Ix sk'anab'ajej winh chi' yoch wa'an, ix em k'ojan winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtankot lajunhwanh heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' winhaj Booz chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh to tz'em k'ojan junok rato heb' winh yet' winh. Ix em k'ojan heb' winh b'i'an.
Ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' t'a winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' heb' chi' icha tik: --Ha ix Noemí ix meltzajxikot t'a Moab, snib'ej ix schonhel jab'ok slu'um winh kuktak xilb'a Elimelec.

Yuj chi' swal t'ayach talaj tza manel lu'um. Tato tzik' lu'um, t'a wal yichanh heb' testigo tik yet' heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' tik, tzalankani to tzik' lu'um. Yujto ha hach tik smoj ik'an lu'um. Tato max ha mankan lum jun, al t'ayin tikne'ik, yujto ha hin tik schab'ilxo makan waji, malaj junokxo syal smanan lu'um, xchi winhaj Booz chi'. Ix tak'wi winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' winhaj Elimelec chi' icha tik: --Ol hin man lu'um, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' tas yaji: --Ha tikne'ik jun, tato tza mankanel lum t'a ix Noemí chi', yowalil tzik' ix Rut aj Moab, ix yetb'eyumkan winh xilb'a Mahlón, yik wach' ol b'inajkan winh yetb'eyum ix chi' t'a lu'um, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Tato icha chi' yaji, max yal-laj hin manan lu'um. Ay talaj tz'ik'an hin makb'en yuj. Tato tza nib'ej tza mankanel lum ha hach tik, syal ha manan lu'um, swak' hin derecho tik t'ayach, xchi winh.

(Ha sb'eyb'al heb' israel t'a jun pekti' chi', tato ay junok mach ay yalan yik smanankan smakb'en junok te ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok, tato max yal sk'o'ol smanani syal yak'ankan b'aj ay yalan yik chi' t'a junokxo mach. Ayik sb'o jun lolonel chi', ha sb'eyb'al heb' to ha jun mach max manankan chi', syik'el junok xanhab' ayochi, syak'an t'a winh smanankan chi', ch'oxnab'il tz'ajkani.)
Yuj chi' ix yal winh sk'ab' yok winhaj Elimelec chi' t'a winhaj Booz chi': --Mankanel lu'um, xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel jun xanhab' winh, ix yak'ankanb'at winh t'a winhaj Booz chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Booz chi' t'a heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' yet' jantak heb' ayek' chi': --He masanil, testigo tzex ajkan tikne'ik to ha hin tzin mankanel lum t'a ix Noemí, haton slu'um winhaj Elimelec, lum yik winhaj Quelión, lum yik winhaj Mahlón.

Hanhejtona' testigo tzex ajpaxkani to ol wik'kan ix Rut aj Moab wetb'eyumok, haton ix yetb'eyumkan winhaj Mahlón, yik ol b'inajnhejkan winh t'a slu'um chi' yet' t'a ko kal ha honh ayto ku'uj ko b'a yet' winh yet' t'a yol ko chonhab' tik. Yuj chi' testigo tzex ajkan t'a jun lolonel tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' yet' masanil heb' ayek' chi' icha tik: --Testigo tzonh ajkani. Ha ix ix tz'ochkan t'a yol ha pat chi', a'okab' Jehová ol ak'an elk'och ix icha ix Raquel yet' ix Lea b'aj kotnak kinhtilal ha honh israel honh tik. Hanhejtona' ha hach pax tik, niwanokab' tz'aj ha b'inajkan t'a yol yik Efrata, haton chonhab' Belén tik.
Tzijtumokab' uninal ol yak' Jehová yet' ix, k'ib'okab'nhej sb'isul inhtilal yet' ix, icha ix aj sk'ib'cha'anh yinhtilal winhaj Fares, haton winh yuninal winhaj Judá yet' ix Tamar, xchi heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'an ix Rut chi' winhaj Booz chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix way winh yet' ix, haxo Jehová ix ak'an swach'k'olal t'a ix, ix skuchanoch yune' ix, ix alji jun swinak unin ix.
Ix yalan heb' ix ix t'a ix Noemí chi' icha tik: --Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto toxo ix yak' jun i'achikin ilumalok. Niwanokab' ol aj sb'inaj t'a skal chonhab' Israel.

A'okab' winh ol och yipok ha k'o'ol yet' hach yilani ayik ol hach chichimaxok, yujto yune' winh ix alib' tik. Haton ix tzach xajanani, ek'b'al yelk'och ix t'a yichanh ichato ay ukwanhok une' ix il sat, xchi heb' ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix schelank'e winh unin chi' ix Noemí chi', haxo ix ix ilan k'ib' winh.

Ayik ix yilan heb' ix kajan t'a slak'anil ix chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ichato ix alji yune' ix Noemí, xchi heb' ix. Obed ix yak' heb' ix sb'i'ej, haton winh smam winhaj Isaí, smam winhaj rey David.

Haton heb' smam yicham winhaj rey David t'a stzolal tik, tz'el yich t'a winhaj Fares, winhaj Hezrón, winhaj Ram, winhaj Aminadab, winhaj Naasón, winhaj Salmón, winhaj Booz, winhaj Obed, winhaj Isaí, haton winh smam winhaj David chi'.
